## Interactive Visualizations Portfolio

This gallery showcases various data visualizations ported using the `animint2` package.

```{r echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Your specific GitHub repo names
repos <- c(
  "ten-points-animint", 
  "iris-animint-test", 
  "worldbank-animint-test", 
  "kmeans-animint-test", 
  "mc-sample-mean-test", 
  "buffon-needle-test", 
  "rosling-bubbles-test"
)

cat("| Screenshot | Project Title | Links |\n")
cat("|:---:|:---|:---|\n")

for(repo in repos){
  # Construction of URLs
  demo_url <- paste0("[https://aakritixyz.github.io/](https://aakritixyz.github.io/)", repo, "/")
  code_url <- paste0("[https://github.com/aakritixyz/](https://github.com/aakritixyz/)", repo)
  
  # Image URL (pointing to main branch where your Capture.PNG lives)
  img_url  <- paste0("[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aakritixyz/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aakritixyz/)", repo, "/main/Capture.PNG")
  
  # Image tag with fallback for lowercase 'capture.png'
  img_tag <- paste0("<a href='", demo_url, "'><img src='", img_url, "' width='250' onerror=\"this.src='[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aakritixyz/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aakritixyz/)", repo, "/main/capture.png'\" style='border:1px solid #ddd; border-radius:8px; padding:5px;' alt='Visualization Screenshot'></a>")
  
  # Formatting the Project Title (removing suffixes for a cleaner look)
  proj_name <- gsub("-animint|-test", "", repo)
  proj_name <- tools::toTitleCase(gsub("-", " ", proj_name))
  
  # Link formatting
  links <- paste0("<strong>[View Interactive Demo](", demo_url, ")</strong><br>[Source Code (GitHub)](", code_url, ")")
  
  cat(paste0("| ", img_tag, " | ### ", proj_name, " | ", links, " |\n"))
}
